title: Bleeding Control Tourniquet
description: Identifies arterial, venous, and capillary bleeding and follows an escalating sequence: direct pressure, wound packing, pressure points, then tourniquet. Covers applying commercial and improvised tourniquets, bleeding from the scalp, neck, chest, and junctional areas, internal bleeding, and a bleeding control kit.
shortDescription: Direct pressure, wound packing, and applying a CAT or improvised tourniquet
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
